name: Closure London
_theme: closurelondon.com: white page, Helvetica/Arial throughout (no web font), #171717 headings, #676869 grey body and product names (14px regular), regular-weight hero titles ('New Arrivals', 30px) over tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows ('MENSWEAR'), square black buttons with white 12px labels ('Shop Mens'; white on imagery for Womens 'Shop Now'), light grey #f2f2f2 announcement bar with the Trustpilot score, orange Outlet link, sale prices struck through in grey. Theme ink is #000000 so the derived muted grey passes WCAG AA.

EU customs update — from 1 July 2026
The EU now applies a €3 customs charge to orders arriving from outside the EU valued at €150 or less. Depending on your order, this may apply to more than one item type. It's separate from VAT and delivery fees.

Our return policy lasts 28 days. If 28 days have passed since the day you received your order, a refund will no longer be offered.
To be eligible for a return, your item(s) must be unused and in the same condition that you received them in, in the original packaging with labels attached.
Socks and underwear are non-refundable due to hygiene reasons.
To process your return, please visit our returns portal.

Students can now benefit from 10% off at Closurelondon.com.
1. Verify your education status
2. Once verified, collect your discount code
3. Enter your code when you checkout
Our student discount is currently only available in the United Kingdom. Key workers get 10% off too.

Earn points for purchases, referrals and more, and redeem them for discounts, early access to drops and sales, and perks.
5 points per £1 · 100 points for signing up · 400 birthday points
Tiers: Bronze, Silver (spend £75), Gold (spend £150, 6 points per £1), VIP (spend £300, 8 points per £1).

Our dedicated team is available to assist you during the following hours (excluding UK public holidays):
Monday – Friday: 07:30 – 17:30
Saturday – Sunday: 11:00 – 19:00
Get in touch: hello@closurelondon.com
Please allow 48–72 hours for a response. We aim to resolve all enquiries as efficiently as possible.
